name: Герои-заглушки: сет 1 «Хранители Песочных Часов» (docs/content/герои/цикл-1.md), по классу на каждого. Рецепт Ильмерры из refs-6.json: тот же стиль, кадр и референсы
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. No bodies, no skulls, no blood.

heroes.frame: Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. Half-body, three-quarter view, head in the upper third, face well lit and readable at small size; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

jobs.title: Гарт Нишевой — дворф, танк, Земля (сет 1)
jobs.subject: Subject: Garth the Niche-cutter, a dwarf tank of the Earth school, a keeper who cut niches in the mountain for the hourglasses of miners who had passed away. A broad, weathered dwarf of middle age with a heavy braided beard grey with stone dust, a strong calm face, deep-set patient eyes. A leather stonecutter's apron over dark chainmail, thick forearms; a heavy square shield like a slab of cut stone with a niche carved in its face, strapped to his arm; a stonecutter's hammer and chisel at his belt. He stands squarely behind his shield, immovable. Faint amber light of the Earth school glows in the cracks of the stone and along the shield's edge. Background: a hall carved inside a dwarven mountain; its walls are covered with rows of small niches, each exactly the width of a palm, each holding a small dusty hourglass; one tall niche cut to a full body's height stands empty in the wall behind him. Warm amber crystal light rises from below, stone dust hangs in the air.

jobs.title: Хравн Сборщик — северянин, физ ДД ловкости, Огонь (сет 1)
jobs.subject: Subject: Hravn the Gatherer, a northern warrior, a quick agile fighter of the Fire school; after every battle he gathered the hourglasses of the fallen and carried them home. Lean, sinewy and quick, a weathered face, a braided red-blond beard with iron rings, long hair tied back, a leather-and-fur northern jerkin, bracers. Two light hand axes: one hangs ready in his right hand, the other at his belt; small embers of the Fire school glow along their edges. Over his shoulder hangs a heavy leather sack bulging with hourglasses; in his left hand he holds up a small hourglass he has just picked from the sand and looks at it with a grave face. Background: a battlefield in the cold north after a battle, at dusk: pale sand drifts over dropped shields, spears and helmets, the wind carries sand across the field. Red-orange ember light rises from below, sparks and sand drift in the wind.

jobs.title: Мирт Переписчик — человек запада, дебаффер, Вода (сет 1)
jobs.subject: Subject: Mirt the Copyist, a man of the western lands, a debuffer of the Water school; a keeper who began writing down who the dead had been. A thin, careful scholar of middle years, clean-shaven, tired kind eyes, ink-stained fingers, a dark blue scholar's coat with a worn collar; he holds a writing board with a sheet of paper and a quill and writes a single line. Frost creeps from the tip of his quill across the paper and curls around his fingers as thin chains of ice — the Water school. Background: a quiet stone crypt beneath a temple hill, low arches, stone shelves along the walls with folded written sheets and small hourglasses laid on them; cold blue light spills from under an arch behind him. The crypt is calm, clean and dignified, it smells of stone, not of death.

jobs.title: Лаэйра — эльфийка, маг ДД, Время (сет 1)
jobs.subject: Subject: Laeira, an elven woman, a mage of the Time school, the last keeper of the brotherhood of hourglass keepers. Young by elven measure but serious; a narrow fine face, dark hair pinned up with a few loose strands, pointed elven ears, attentive grey-green eyes; a long dark robe with thin green trim of the Time school. She holds an old hourglass with a scratched glass and turns it over: the glass is empty, no sand falls, and around her a few grains of sand hang motionless in the air, stopped in time, glowing faint green. Background: her hall in the Time quarter of the city: long tables covered with empty hourglasses of every size; through a tall arched window, the rooftops of the quarter with big hourglass shapes over the roofs. Soft green light of the Time school rises from below.
